why: The output has no expect lines or proof entries at all. It only contains a "blocked" reason, which says the request is a question ("why does mathlib use CommonJS") rather than a change, and suggests answering it as a discussion. Because there are no expect lines, none of them can depend on a release, deploy, published page or anything else that exists only after merge, so the criterion holds by default. Blocking also fits this request: a question gives no outcome a verifier could check at the pull request's head. Nothing in the output breaks the requirement that every line be checkable before merge.
